description: This file defines the strategy for handling ConfigMap objects in Kubernetes, including creation, update, validation, and filtering logic.

classes.name: strategy
classes.description: Implements behavior for ConfigMap objects, including validation and update logic.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Indicates that ConfigMaps are namespace scoped.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Prepares a ConfigMap object for creation, e.g., dropping disabled fields.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Returns warnings upon creation of a ConfigMap.

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Indicates if creation on update is allowed (false).

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares a ConfigMap object for update.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a ConfigMap.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns warnings upon updating a ConfigMap.

methods.name: AllowUnconditionalUpdate
methods.description: Indicates if unconditional updates are allowed (true).

methods.name: GetAttrs
methods.description: Retrieves labels and fields for filtering ConfigMaps.

methods.name: Matcher
methods.description: Creates a selection predicate for filtering.

methods.name: SelectableFields
methods.description: Returns fields used for filtering ConfigMaps.
